author: Lilitari
scope: Private deterministic mathematical diagnostics only. No biological material, clinical intervention, product formulation, patient data, model API calls, or hardware.
question_S: Can greater wall transfer increase total uptake while decreasing distal tissue oxygen in a supply-limited serial channel?
question_H: Do equilibrium unloading and finite-contact-time positive controls behave as their exact algebra predicts?
randomness: None. All numerical inputs are explicit; no Monte Carlo inference.
decision: A valid counterexample replaces an unconditional distal-oxygen permeability monotonicity test with separate local fixed-supply and coupled finite-supply tests. It does not validate Coda's unavailable PF0 implementation.
limits: No actual skin or clinical survival threshold
Dimensionless S parameters deliberately not assigned to a formulation
H parameters are synthetic test cases, not fitted HbV or human dosing recommendations
Same-author algebra/numerical cross-check is not independent replication
revision_note: r1 retained: finest-grid Simpson balance error exceeded 1e-8. r2 adds N512; numerical tolerance unchanged. This is analytic solver verification, not a held-out biological inference.
